name: wayback
description: Check the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine for saved snapshots of a URL: whether one exists, a calendar of all known snapshots, or a direct viewing URL for a specific date.

action.description: check: closest available snapshot. calendar: list of all known snapshot timestamps. view_url: generate a direct snapshot viewing URL, optionally for a specific date.

date.description: Specific date in YYYYMMDD format. Only used for action='view_url' (optional - omit for closest snapshot).
